method.projection_definition: official NVTX GPU Projection Trace; first GPU op start to last GPU op end
method.sync_interval_note: Adjacent cudaDeviceSynchronize return timestamps include small loop overhead; diagnostic only.
method.sql_kernel_mapping:
SELECT k.start, k.end, k.correlationId, k.gridX, k.gridY, k.gridZ,
 k.blockX, k.blockY, k.blockZ, k.streamId, s.value AS name
 FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=k.demangledName
 JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r ON r.correlationId=k.correlationId
 AND (r.globalTid >> 24)=(k.globalPid >> 24)
 WHERE r.start>=? AND r.start<? AND (r.globalTid & 16777215)=?
 ORDER BY k.start
